text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, thank you for your hard work.
Um, thank you so much for today as well...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today's training wrapped up before noon.
Just as I was thinking about taking it easy in the afternoon for the first time in a while—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's already... lunchtime, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... I got the wrong idea.
I'm so, so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll be more careful from now on...!
So, um... please take care of me tomorrow too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had intended to give her money for yesterday's lunch, but...
before I could even speak, she had already run off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What did she mean by getting the wrong idea? Without a chance to ask,
I could only watch Nishino Flower's retreating figure.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—That afternoon. While walking near the station,
I ran into Nishino Flower, who was out shopping.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Um, are you out shopping too, Trainer...?
I came to buy some training shoes.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
My parents said it was time for me to get a new pair,
so they sent more allowance than usual...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...It's been like this even before I entered Tracen Academy.
They've always given me so much support with my training...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...! Mom, Dad!
I... want to run more! I want to run in lots of races!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
! Of course! We'll support you with everything we've got!
First, shoes! We need to buy you good ones! And then...

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Let's find a place to train! Somewhere you can run to your heart's content!
We might as well buy a large plot of land and set up proper facilities...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
They prepared so many things I needed for running.
So much that I wondered if it was okay to receive all this...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! They're so kind... I'm so proud of my mom and dad!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But... whenever I buy things myself, I always struggle to decide.
I have to use the money carefully, and make sure I pick the right one.
choice_data_list: Want me to come along and help?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? But aren't you in the middle of shopping, Trainer?
I'd feel bad... taking up your time just for me...
choice_data_list: I was just out for a walk.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Really? In that case... um, okay!
I'll make sure not to take up too much of your time!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Rather than standard training shoes,
weighted ones that add resistance would... but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (For my training, ones with added resistance seem better, but...)

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
—I think you'll need to focus on rehabilitation for a while.
I'll call a car, so let's go to the hospital just to be safe.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Even though your second growth spurt has started, your body is still maturing.
If you push yourself too hard, the toll will show immediately. ...You understand, right?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Good girl. Don't worry. As long as you properly rehab,
you'll be able to train again. For now, take it easy, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (If something like that happens again...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I can't let that happen! It would worry Mom and Dad,
and cause so much trouble for Trainer, too...!)
choice_data_list: There are other ways to add load to your training.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to add extra weight throughout the whole session.
There are plenty of methods, like using heavier horseshoes when needed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's best to adjust according to the situation.
After I offer this gentle advice—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Y-You're right!
I'm so sorry for taking up your time with something like this...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, you took time out of your day to come with me,
and here I was, worrying all by myself...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer!
I'll go with the regular training shoes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I won't let your advice go to waste!
I'll do my very best again starting tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that, Nishino Flower heads to the register.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I only meant to offer a casual tip,
but perhaps she took it too heavily.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It's already gotten so late, hasn't it?
...I'm so sorry for dragging you around today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When I get back, I'll prep them so I can wear them first thing tomorrow!
And I'll switch back to my usual horseshoes, to make sure—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It's definitely not my imagination; something is off.
She seems overly cautious about not making me worry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower is deeply considerate. She is always mindful of others,
treading carefully so as not to become a bother or a burden.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And she's treating me, her Trainer, the exact same way.
—But things can't go on like this.
choice_data_list: (I want her to open up to me more...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She can burden me as much as she needs. If something is bothering her,
I want her to confide in me without holding back. That's what a Trainer is for.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Um... is something wrong...?
choice_data_list: I'm going to do my best too!!
I'm going to do my best too!!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?! O-Oh, yes!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Y-You startled me...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, it's okay! But... ehehe. Trainer,
you're already working so, so hard for my sake.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my very best too,
so I don't fall behind all your hard work!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the smile Nishino Flower turns toward me, I vow to myself once more:
I'll do whatever it takes to keep that smile from fading.
